$comment: The DeepFilterNet3 runtime assets, pinned by size and SHA-256.
One table, read by two sides. scripts/fetch-denoise-assets.mjs downloads against
it; electron/denoise/assets.ts imports it, so electron-vite compiles the digests
into the app bundle rather than shipping them as a file sitting next to the assets
they vouch for, and re-checks each file when the engine loads.
The ONNX model comes straight from the upstream DeepFilterNet repository at a
pinned tag. The WebAssembly build is compiled from that same project's
libDF --features wasm target, but upstream publishes no prebuilt .wasm, so it is
mirrored from the CDN that the deepfilternet3-noise-filter and
deepfilter-standalone packages use. The digest is what makes that safe.
